value.rationale: Resolves the field q=37, explicitly left as a natural unresolved candidate in 2015, for all split smooth degree-two del Pezzo surfaces without arbitrary coefficient restrictions. Sharpens possible odd-prime-power bound from 37 to 31 and explains an intrinsic incidence obstruction: fullness requires at least 22 fourfold bitangent points, contrary to the universal maximum 21 in characteristic 37.
